parsed.note_claim: Similar stories about Ugandan gay couples being jailed until one gets pregnant have been debunked as fabricated, and no Ugandan court issued such a ruling.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: There is no evidence to validate the claim that President Museveni of Uganda said a jailed gay couple will be released only when one gets pregnant. Thus, the claim is FALSE.
parsed.reason: The 2021 fact-check debunks a similar earlier version of the claim (attributed to Museveni), supporting the 'similar stories debunked' point, but does not address the February 2026 post, the 10-month ruling, or the Kenyan satirical origin of the images.
